_comment: All numeric budget values in this file are raw bytes.

_comment_metrics.publishedTarballSize: Bytes of the final npm .tgz archive produced by `npm pack --dry-run`. This is the compressed download size from the registry.
_comment_metrics.publishedUnpackedSize: Bytes of the package contents once the npm tarball is extracted.
_comment_metrics.publishedWebRuntimeSize: Bytes of the published web runtime entry file itself, before gzip/brotli compression.
_comment_metrics.publishedNativeRuntimeSize: Bytes of the published react-native runtime entry file itself, before gzip/brotli compression.
_comment_metrics.localWebRuntimeGzip: Bytes of the local `dist/index.mjs` runtime file after gzip compression.
_comment_metrics.localNativeRuntimeGzip: Bytes of the local `dist/index.native.mjs` runtime file after gzip compression.
_comment_metrics.localWebRuntimeBrotli: Bytes of the local `dist/index.mjs` runtime file after brotli compression.
_comment_metrics.localNativeRuntimeBrotli: Bytes of the local `dist/index.native.mjs` runtime file after brotli compression.
